denial.payer_remark: Records of conservative treatment are required.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-06-12
Patient: 73-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: right knee pain from osteoarthritis
Radiograph of the right knee, 2025-11-24: joint-space narrowing and osteophytes, consistent with osteoarthritis.
Naproxen 500 mg twice daily started 2026-01-31; still taking it with little relief.
Supervised physical therapy: 12 sessions from 2026-02-14 to 2026-04-11; pain unchanged.
Examination: crepitus, small effusion, flexion limited to 100 degrees.
Procedure: hyaluronan injected into the right knee.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-06-12.

expected.rationale: The record is complete and shows about 4 months of treatment, but this payer requires 6. Sending the records would document that the requirement was not met. The same record would satisfy the other payer.
